== Achievements ==
'''1997'''
* 2nd place in Autumn Gambleriada Quake 1on1 Tournament, winner: [[K3]] (who also won Gamleriada's Spring edition), Warsaw.
* 1st place in unofficial Polish 1on1 Championships, Adax Gnet Cup, winning probably best prize ever in Polish Q1 tournament (~2000 USD in computer hardware) and gaining unofficial Master of Poland title, Wroclaw (some more info: https://shorturl.at/6G20v).


'''1998'''
* 2nd place in Arno Quake 1on1 Tournament, winner [[Macler]], Bielawa
* 1st place in AdaxLand 1on1 Tournament, Jelenia Gora.
* 2nd place in First Open Polish Internet QW [[HPB]] 1on1 Championships, winner [[K3]].
* 1st place in Zeto 1on1 Tournament, Jelenia Gora.
* 2nd place in first edition of Polish Clan 4on4 League (with [[The Immortals]]).
* 2nd place in second edition of Polish Clan 4on4 League (with [[Death Dealers]]).
* Co-organizer of Myslowice Frag Party 1st and 2nd Edition (around 40 participants from whole Poland).


'''1999'''
* 1st place in Zeto 1on1 Second Edition Tournament, Jelenia Gora.
* 4th place in last big polish QW 1on1 tournament known as Grudziadz Tournament, winner [[Macler]], runner-up [[Headhunter]].
* Co-organizer of Myslowice Frag Party 3rd and 4th Edition (around 70 participants from whole Poland and even several guests from Czech Republic).


'''2000'''
* 1st place in 1on1 Rybnik Tournament Qualifications and Finals, Rybnik.
* Co-organizer and main admin of Q3 CKT Internet (qualifications) and LAN (finals) Polish National Tournament.


----
September 2000 to July 2004 - break from all QW/Q3 related stuff
----


'''2004'''
* [[Death Dealers]] successful reactivation.
* 5th place in first Polish Duelmania, winner [[Avenger]], runner up [[Insane]].


'''2005'''
* 4th place in second Polish Duelmania, winner [[Avenger]], runner up [[Insane]].
* 3rd place in Division 2 [[EQL]]1 with [[Death Dealers]], lost only 1 point to winners.
* Participation in Polish National 4on4 QW Team in [[QWWC]] 2005 Edition along with [[Insane]], [[Avenger]] and [[Macler]], reaching semifinals (league eventually died after that).
* Bringing about the idea of Polish QuakeWorld community forum (http://forum.quakeworld.pl), setting up quakeworld.pl domain, admin of both.


'''2006'''
* 5th place in Division 2 [[EQL]]4 with [[Death Dealers]], lost only 1 point to 2nd place.
* D2.quakeworld.pl and Grendel.quakeworld.pl servers admin, E7.quakeworld.pl and Quake.aster.pl servers co-admin.
* Author and maintainer of the ServeMeFilter plugin for XChat (http://quakeworld.pl/servemefilter/).


'''2007'''
* 5th place (tie) in Gold Cup [[NQR]]10 with [[Death Dealers]]
* 1st place in Division 2 [[EQL]]5 with [[Death Dealers]], winning both group stage and playoffs (https://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql5/division.php?id=2).


----
March 2008 to November 2023 - living a life
----


'''2023'''
* Back again!
* Joined the [[GoodFellas]] clan after being invited by [[Airman]].
----


'''2024'''
* 4th place in 1on1 open at [[QW LAN Party Poland 2024]].
* With [[GoodFellas]], took 2nd place in the [[EQL cup 3]] DIV2 tournament (lost the final to [[KOFF]]).
* With [[GoodFellas]], took 2nd place in the [[Quakeworld Eternal]] Schloss tournament (lost the final to [[Black Book]]). GoodFellas' results in that tournament were later voided because in [[Quakeworld Eternal]] DM2, GoodFellas' clan leader - [[Airman]] - was caught cheating and admitted he had already been cheating during previous [[Quakeworld Eternal]] Schloss round.
* As a result of the events above, the [[GoodFellas]] fell apart, and the [[Death Dealers]] clan was reactivated by Plast.
----
